About our company

About Drain With Trenchless

Drain With Trenchless clears and repairs drain and sewer lines for homes and businesses across the South Bay. We camera every line before recommending anything, so the fix matches the problem — and when a pipe needs replacing, we do it without digging up your property.

  • Camera inspection before any repair recommendation
  • Trenchless relining — no torn-up yards or driveways
  • Rooter, hydro jetting, and leak detection in-house
  • Emergency repair — proudly serving veterans
Learn more about us  →
How it works

Our Service Process

Four stages, in order, so you always know what happens next and who is doing it.

01

Call or Book

Tell us which drains are slow, what's backing up, and how long it's been happening.

02

Camera Inspection

We run a camera through the line and show you the clog, crack, or root intrusion on screen.

03

Price & Repair Plan

You get the number and the plan up front. Nothing starts until you approve both.

04

Clear, Repair & Verify

Line cleared or repaired, work area cleaned up, and a final camera pass to confirm it flows.

Why Choose Drain With Trenchless?

Plenty of outfits will snake a drain and leave. We'd rather show you what's actually in the line, so you're not paying for the same clog again next month.

Common questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does drain or sewer repair cost?

It depends on the line, what's in it, and whether it needs cleaning or repair. We inspect first, give you a written price before anything starts, and you decide from there.

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. The initial consultation and estimate are free.

What is trenchless sewer repair?

Instead of digging a trench along the whole pipe, we repair or replace it through small access points — usually by relining the old pipe from the inside. Your yard, driveway, and landscaping stay intact.

Do you handle emergencies?

Yes. If sewage is backing up or a line has burst, call (310) 493-4527 and we'll get someone out to stop the damage.

When do I need a camera inspection?

If a drain clogs repeatedly, you have multiple slow drains at once, or you're buying an older home, a camera inspection shows the condition of the line before you spend money on repairs.

What areas do you serve?

The South Bay and surrounding Los Angeles County cities, including Torrance, Carson, Gardena, Redondo Beach, Lomita, and San Pedro.
